title: Final Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for C_v must be correctly stated as C_v = (1/kT^2) * <(E - <E>)^2>.

title: Partition Function
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly define the partition function Z and its relation to the average energy <E>.

title: Derivative of Average Energy
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly compute the derivative of <E> with respect to T, showing the necessary steps.

title: Fluctuation Relation
description: Important Criteria: The derivation must include the relationship between C_v and the mean-square fluctuation in energy.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors when differentiating and applying the chain rule.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Mathematical Clarity
description: Optional Criteria: The response should be clearly organized, with logical flow and proper mathematical notation.

title: Alternative Methods
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention alternative methods or checks that could verify the result.
